next.reason: 1985: "CODE-SET IS alphabet-name-1"; 2023: "CODE-SET { IS alphabet-name-1 [ alphabet-name-2 ] | FOR ALPHANUMERIC IS alphabet-name-1 / FOR NATIONAL IS alphabet-name-2 }". The 1985 form is still valid in 2023. The format adds an optional national alphabet-name-2 and FOR ALPHANUMERIC/FOR NATIONAL phrases, so more programs are accepted.
